filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username or phone

resetPin.title: Reset the PIN of {{name}}?
resetPin.description: A temporary 6-digit PIN is created and shown once for you to hand over. The account is unlocked, every open session is signed out, and the person must change the PIN at the next sign-in.
resetPin.note: Recorded in the activity log. Not available for the super admin account.

tempPin.title: Temporary PIN of {{name}}
tempPin.description: Hand this PIN to the person. It is shown only once; they must change it at their first sign-in.
tempPin.label: Temporary PIN

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: The account can no longer sign in and every open session is signed out now. History is kept; the account can be enabled again later.

toast.accessSaved: Saved the access of {{name}}. It applies now.

fields.usernameHint: 3–30 lower-case letters without accents or digits. Cannot be changed later.
fields.pinHint: 6 digits. The person changes it at the first sign-in.

createDialog.title: Add staff
createDialog.description: One permission group per branch. Assign more branches on the detail page after creating.

detail.accessDescription: One group per branch; access at one branch does not apply at another. You can only assign groups whose permissions you hold yourself.
detail.accessNote: A group change applies at once to every open session and is recorded in the activity log (before/after).
detail.notWorkingHere: Does not work at this branch
detail.effectiveDescription: At the selected branch, with limits
detail.effectiveEmpty: This person has no access at any branch.
detail.approvable: No · can ask for approval on the spot
detail.superAdminNote: The super admin password can only be reset with a command on the server.
detail.selfNote: This is your own account. Change your PIN from the account menu.
